notes.title: Gamescom 2025, Visual Update & Physical Edition
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Rabbits,[/b] 

We're thrilled to share some exciting news and updates about Bye Sweet Carole! 🌹[/p][h3]
[b]Road to Gamescom 2025[/b][/h3][p]For the very first time, Bye Sweet Carole will be playable during Gamescom 2025 in Germany, and we sincerely can't wait to welcome you to experience what we've been crafting with passion over the past 3 years.

The playable demo will be available at the [b]Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2),[/b] so if you're attending, be sure to stop and say hi! 
[/p][h3][b]Updated Visual Style[/b][/h3][p]We’ve made refinements to the game’s visual direction to further embrace the classic animation film aesthetic that inspired us. As Bye Sweet Carole’s creator, Chris Darril, explains:[/p][p] “We wanted to have this nice and authentic effect, close to what we can call ‘chromatic aberration’, that gives a vintage, warmer and more emotional aspect to the game and to Lana’s adventures.”   

Here are a few new screenshots showcasing these visual updates:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/592af3b89ff3d75b9c4b3b00db3cdde6744760e2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/a949ea228a46b0667bf9928aada7a88a250f9e2b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/f3330161b238c198106627f8efc7dc19d7af101f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/ec0e909afc2239f7d924d52b0236a13584a45ca4.png"][/img]
[b]Physical Editions[/b][/p][p]Finally, we’re excited to share that Bye Sweet Carole will also be releasing physically on PS5 and Nintendo Switch! Here’s a little sneak peek, with more details to come soon, including some exclusive bonuses we can’t wait to reveal!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/d288a2dac8263398e1cd6a08d8256a663b246585.png"][/img]
You can already pre-order the game at your local retailer or at [url="https://byesweetcarole.com/"]https://byesweetcarole.com/[/url] 

We hope you'll enjoy this haunting yet beautiful journey into the kingdom of Corrola. 

Stay tuned for more exciting news coming very soon!   

[i]Little Sewing Machine & Maximum Entertainment[/i][/p]

notes.title: Introducing the young and rich Lord DeWitt!
notes.content:
Dear rabbits,

Happy Valentine's Day to everyone!
We truly hope that you'll find your other half of the apple to share this special day together. ♥

It's time for some reveal around Bye Sweet Carole, and what a better day to present our very own kind of [b][i]Prince Charming[/i][/b]?

[h2]Please, welcome the young and rich "Lord DeWitt"! [/h2]
[previewyoutube=IvEEPgNazpM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Lord DeWitt[/b] is the young offspring of an aristocratic family. He is kind and has a nonconventional way of living. He belongs to a group of nobles that are acquiring the land near Bunny Hall to build factories on top of an old park infested with rabbits...

[b][i] How is this unexpected "Prince Charming" coming in the help of Lana? Does he know anything about the mysterious disappearance of Carole? [/i][/b] 

[i]You'll have to wait to learn more once Bye Sweet Carole launches later this year. [/i]

[i][h3]For the time being... Here are some early sketches of Lord DeWitt![/h3][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/2f83a6bc0fc11180adba66d5369196a2f6f96159.png[/img]

[h3]Happy Valentine's Day once more! ♥[/h3]

notes.title: See What Lurks in the Midnight Trailer
notes.content:
Dear rabbits,

Today, we're proud to share with you the first Bye Sweet Carole gameplay trailer in over a year! Aired during the Indie Horror Showcase from DreadXP, the "[b]Midnight Trailer[/b]" shows a glimpse of Bye Sweet Carole's revamped art, some of Bunny Hall and Corolla's threats, and much more. 

We named it midnight after the clock tower hitting the symbolic hour... 
Midnight has always been the most mysterious and eerie hour of the day, where anything can happen... so who knows what could come next?

[previewyoutube=IbyR389243o;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]The voices that you're hearing from the trailer are actually part of the game itself, as the game is entirely voiced in English and in Italian. [/i]

[h2]The Bye Sweet Carole Website is Live![/h2]

To celebrate the spooky season, we have launched a dedicated Bye Sweet Carole website, where you can discover character lore and more! Head to: [url=https://www.byesweetcarole.com]https://www.byesweetcarole.com[/url].


[h2]Velenia[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/699db6070e211603fc1ee550683f8890aafb0db2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/096e8731f1fb2470dc395d759234554fd4a41145.jpg[/img]

[h3][i]What is her role in Carole's disappearance?[/i]
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/52ffcc618b68ae78599284d72ab7380a7dc714a9.png[/img]
Bye Sweet Carole will launch in 2025 and we cannot wait to show you even more!

Thanks again for your continuous support, and see you soon for a new update.
[h2]Happy Halloween![/h2]

LSM & ME teams

notes.title: Bye Sweet Carole is now releasing in 2025
notes.content:
Dear rabbits,

It's been quite some time since we last shared an update on development with you, and today we are excited to share some of the game's newest improvements for the first time. 

We've been working hard to deliver a beautiful and emotional game, but as anyone who has made a game before knows, it's no easy task. This is why we've made the tough decision to move Bye Sweet Carole's release to 2025. This will give us the proper time to continue improving the quality of the gameplay and art that made you fall in love with the project in the first place. 

Speaking of the improvements that we've made to Bye Sweet Carole, here are a few examples of changes to the [b]ENTIRE[/b] game.

[h3]Lighting Effects[/h3]

We received some feedback on our game being too dark. We agree, it was! We listened and added more lighting effects to give every scene the clarity it deserves to show off the gorgeous art... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/7dd7abf7e0d1de14b721f1fa235d6ede9e6b326e.gif[/img]

[h3]User Interface[/h3]

In our last update we shared a newer version of the UI, but we weren't done iterating. We did extensive research to determine the best UI for the game because you'll be able to control and transform several characters, so the UI needed to work for each one. During this time, we also took our time to revamp the entire menu system as well as the game's HUD. Please note that this may not be final, but it's much closer to what we would like! Please, have a look on our Steam page where all the 4K screenshots have been updated to reflect more examples of the new UI and all other mentioned effects. We're really proud of what we achieved.


[h3]Cutscene Rework[/h3]
We are spending more time to rework every animation frame from every cutscene (and there are quite many, trust us!) to align the work of our wonderful 2D artists and present a cohesive art style for the project. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/4a1d8651f9ae6fc2a11d9ffe3a792994cb6539b4.gif[/img]
[i]Please, note that the GIFs here are exported in lower resolution, but the whole game is in 4K natively![/i]

[h3]Gameplay Reworks[/h3]

We've reworked much of the gameplay to give you a tense feeling while playing. We want your senses heightened like they would with any great horror game or movie. Whether that's when you are holding Lana's breath, hiding or battling it out with Mr. Kyn and other enemies that you may encountered during your journey... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/a1d00272ef920f3a2f82de1b9a967d6e0976666b.jpg[/img]

Once more, thank you all for your continued support of Bye Sweet Carole. We're working on [i]a new gameplay video[/i] to share in the near future, so follow us on Steam or our socials to be kept updated on that as well as other game developments. And if you haven't, please Wishlist Bye Sweet Carole! It helps a ton. ♥

notes.title: We're unveiling the mystery around Carole Simmons for the Holiday Season!
notes.content:
It's that time of the year!

On this occasion, [b]Bye Sweet Carole[/b] has partnered with talented artist Tasia MS to showcase Carole in a special way, to celebrate the Christmas season, and to wish every player a wonderful end of the year! 
The new Holiday Artwork is the perfect opportunity to let players make their best wishes before the tar turns the world of Corolla dark again.

Get ready to meet Lana, Mr.Baesie, Mr.Kyn, and the rottens rabbits in Bye Sweet Carole next year…

[h2]Who is Carole?[/h2]

Carole is one of the most important characters in the game. She is Lana’s best friend. They both lived in the Bunny Hall. However, one day, Carole just left Bunny Hall. Although everyone thinks that she left the orphanage, Lana suspects there was something more behind... Lana will do everything she can to find her, but it won't be easy. Throughout her investigation to find Carole, Lana will encounter many enemies and meets a few allies to support her.

Here are three screenshots on top to see Carole in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/c5fdff7ecbd742fc851a6c421ce6edc2f742cfd9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/c8281c1b46244e211cececb2a525d9d4dd65fbf5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/fa8d5e755218fb27aab721d4701cafa360d51a7f.png[/img]

We wish you all a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year. We look forward to showing you more of Bye Sweet Carole next year!


- LSM & JFG teams

notes.title: Bye Sweet Carole introduces the rotten rabbits and a new keyart by Omri Koresh!
notes.content:
[b]It's time to Scream![/b]

Welcome to our first official blog post! It's been a while since Gamescom and our Gameplay reveal! *


[h1]Bye Sweet Carole is part of Steam Screamfest 2023![/h1]


On this occasion, Bye Sweet Carole has partnered with artist Omri Koresh (known for his work on American McGee’s Alice: Asylum) to create a chilling artwork.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/b8a480905aa2dfd43d184389a37fa2ba3a2cd4fe.png[/img]

Here is a [url=https://www.justforgames.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/4kwallpaper_byesweetcarole_omrikoresh.jpg]version without logo[/url] if you want to use it as a wallpaper! :) 
We also added it into Wallpaper Engine in case you're using it! 

[b][h3]The rottens rabbits[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/0fba4e7041db80581fd1f14ea9b739b38e3e7a1a.png[/img]

We wanted to start introducing to players the different characters that are part of Bye Sweet Carole's story. Halloween is full of terrifying creatures.
The rottens are black rabbits made of tar. The origins of these creatures are unknown, but they are closely related to Mr. Kyn. In fact, by opening portals, he can summon them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219345/df8d11c6f6bdeacb0875d00a5be37e32647b3f06.gif[/img]
Look at our gentle Mr.Baesie fighting against the Rotten while Lana is finding the way to escape this dismal well...

[h3]It's Halloween after all![/h3]

It's the spookiest season of the year, and it's the best time to watch your favorite horror movies or play your favorite horror games? What is your favorite horror game? 

[b][i]We've asked the team about their favorite horror video game and movie, and here are the answers... [/i][/b]

Chris Darril - Game Creator: Clock Tower or Rule Of Rose (game) and Rosemary's Baby (movie)
Luigi Giuseppe Matrone - Game Producer: Silent Hill 2 (game) and The Thing (movie)
Simone Gnaccarini - Cleanup artist: Alien Isolation (game), The Thing (movie)
Lucia Girelli Carasi - Cleanup artist: P.T. (game), Hereditary (movie)
Beatrice Gentili - Cleanup artist: Phasmophobia (game), Hereditary (movie)
Alexia Sapienza - Lead animator: Devotion (game) 
Valeria Tirloni - 2D animator: Layers of Fear (game)
Laura Crosio - 2D animator: Psycho (movie)
Elios Silverstri - 2D animator: Fear and hunger (game), Pan's labyrinth (movie)

and we even asked our guest artist, Omri Koresh, which is currently into Returnal (game) and GInger Snaps 2 (movie) ! 

What are your favorites horror video game and movies? 

[h3][u][b]We wish you a bloody Halloween, and talk to you soon about another character... [/b][/u][/h3]
Little Sewing Machine & Just For Games teams.
